name: Oikko – All-in-One Team Management
author: WP Plugin Studio

sections.description:
🚀 Oikko – All-in-One Team Management is a powerful and user-friendly plugin designed to help you manage your team, communication, and operations directly from your WordPress dashboard.

Whether you’re running a small team or a growing organization, Oikko provides the essential tools to streamline collaboration, track time, manage employees, and organize internal workflows — without needing multiple plugins.

Key Highlights

✔️ Real-time team communication
✔️ Built-in attendance & time tracking
✔️ HR and employee management tools
✔️ Document storage and sharing
✔️ Clean, modern dashboard experience

Free Version Features

Get started with powerful core features:

⭐ Direct Chat – Communicate instantly with team members
⭐ Time Tracking – Clock-in/out and generate time reports
⭐ User Profiles – Update and manage personal information
⭐ Document Management – Upload, store, and organize files
⭐ User Management – Add/edit users, assign roles & designations
⭐ Department Management – Create departments and assign members
⭐ Shift Management – Create and assign work shifts
⭐ Time Zone Support – Easily manage distributed teams

Pro Version Features

Unlock advanced capabilities for growing teams:

⭐ Group Chat – Collaborate in team-based chat groups
⭐ Audio/Video Calls – Built-in calling for real-time communication
⭐ Channel Management – Organize conversations into channels
⭐ Leave Requests – Employees can request leave easily
⭐ Leave Management – Approve, track, and manage leave workflows
⭐ Salary Management – Manage payroll, assign salaries, and maintain records

👉 Upgrade to Pro:
https://wppluginstudio.net/product/oikko-team-management/

Shortcodes

Use the following shortcode to display the frontend dashboard:

[oikkotm_dashboard]<h3>Privacy</h3>

This plugin can optionally connect to the OpenStreetMap Nominatim API
(https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org) to convert coordinates into location
names. This feature is disabled by default and can be turned on or off anytime
from the plugin settings. No personal or identifiable data is transmitted.

Usage Analytics (Appsero)

Oikko – All-in-One Team Management uses Appsero SDK to collect some telemetry data upon user’s confirmation. This helps us to troubleshoot problems faster & make product improvements.

Appsero SDK does not gather any data by default. The SDK only starts gathering basic telemetry data when a user allows it via the admin notice. We collect the data to ensure a great user experience for all our users.

Integrating Appsero SDK DOES NOT IMMEDIATELY start gathering data, without confirmation from users in any case.

Learn more about how Appsero collects and uses this data.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the oikko-team-management folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin via the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to the plugin dashboard and configure your team settings

1.1.0

  • Admin settings updated.

1.0.0

  • Initial release with free features: chat, time tracking, HR, shifts, documents.
